public.heroTitle: Your shipment, visible the moment you look.
public.heroBody: Track a container, request a rate, and download your documents — without waiting for a phone call.
public.featureTrackBody: Milestones, ETA and released documents on any device, in English or Arabic.
public.featureQuoteBody: Priced from our own rate card and returned as a quotation you can act on.
public.featureDocsBody: Bills of lading, invoices and delivery orders, released to you as they are issued.
public.lanesTitle: The corridors we run every week
public.lanesBody: Sea, air and land out of Kuwait and Dubai. If your lane is not on the map, ask — most of what we move started as a route somebody asked us about.

signIn.title: Sign in

quoteForm.costHint: Everything you pay carriers and agents

paymentForm.referenceHint: So it can be matched to the statement

userForm.activeHint: Turn off to suspend them. Takes effect on their next request.

enquiryActions.respondDescription: Stops the reply clock on this enquiry.

enquiryActions.assignDescription: They become responsible for answering it.
enquiryActions.ownerHint: Whoever will price and answer this enquiry
enquiryActions.closeDescription: Records the outcome. A closed enquiry cannot be reopened here.
